name: wattanam-customer-school
description: Self-hostable Wattanam customer-school core and plugin host.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build:core: npm --prefix backend run build:core && npm --prefix frontend run build:core
scripts.test:core: node --test frontend/scripts/build-core.test.js tools/core-container-contract.test.js tools/core-release-workflow.test.js tools/distribution-default.test.js tools/frontend-navigation-registry.test.js tools/generate-core-release-blueprint.test.js tools/provision-railway-school.test.js tools/railway-container-command.test.js tools/railway-core-hosted-preflight.test.js tools/railway-iac-contract.test.js
